rules.tracking: tracking-tight for H1 and H2, normal for body

typography.instructions: Import Rajdhani, Oswald, and Inter from Google Fonts. Use Rajdhani for all headings (H1-H4) to give that high-energy sports broadcast feel. Use Oswald for small accents, labels, and stat numbers. Inter is for body text. All headings must be uppercase to match sports network aesthetics.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl with bg-[#16161D]/70 for sticky headers and overlay cards to simulate glass studio screens.
visual_enhancers.glow_effects: Use drop-shadows with analyst-specific colors to create a 'neon/LED' studio lighting effect behind their avatars or stat cards.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #2D2D35 (brushed steel aesthetic) on cards and panels.
visual_enhancers.gradients: Avoid generic gradients. Use radial gradients softly behind character avatars to highlight their signature colors.

layouts.home_page: Top sticky ticker banner with continuous scroll. Below that, a 4-column Bento grid for the analysts panel on desktop, 1-column on mobile.
layouts.ask_analyst: Studio-style framing. Selected analyst portrait prominent, streaming text area for the AI response, and a compact stat card next to it.
layouts.predictions: Dashboard layout. Grid of pickable games, personal accuracy charts, and a public leaderboard.
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-6 or p-8 inside cards.

components.ticker: Use `react-fast-marquee` for a continuous scrolling sports ticker at the very top of the app. It must contain live-feeling stats, news, or banter.
components.analyst_card: Interactive card with hover state that brightens their signature color. Avatar, name, title, and a 'Ask' button.
components.stat_card: High contrast numbers using Oswald font, arranged in a dense grid.
components.loader: In-character loading states (e.g., 'Dozer is lacing up his skates...', 'Lucky is checking the prompter...') with a pulsating glow in their signature color.

motion.transitions: Smooth transitions on hover (`transition-transform duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg`).
motion.typing_effect: Simulate AI typing for answers to mimic live broadcasting or teleprompter feed.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over glassmorphism has sufficient contrast (white on dark grey/black).
accessibility.data_testid: All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute.

studio_bg.description: Studio background for the Ask Analyst screen

hockey_action.description: Ice hockey action shot for Predictions dashboard header

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a premium, high-octane dark sports broadcast UI. Use #0D0D11 for the root background and #16161D for cards with a 1px solid #2D2D35 border. The top banner must be a continuous marquee ticker using react-fast-marquee. Implement 4 distinct analyst profiles on the home page. When an analyst is selected, transition to the 'Ask Analyst' view with a studio background, their portrait, their signature accent color illuminating the UI, and a simulated typing effect for the AI answer. Use Rajdhani font for ALL headings in uppercase, Oswald for numbers/accents, and Inter for standard body text. Embed character in microcopy (e.g. 'Dozer is lacing up...'). Keep it confident, funny, and insider.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts. Create depth with z-index and glassmorphism. Add micro-animations on all interactive elements. Do not apply universal 'transition: all'. Add data-testid to all interactive elements. Never use AI assistant emojis. Use the provided image URLs.
